title: Iran’s cement production rises 7% year-on-year in first seven months of 2026
summary: Iran’s cement production rises 7% year-on-year in first seven months of 2026
body_markdown:
**Iran:** Iran’s cement production increased by 7% year-on-year to 40.4Mt in the first seven months of the Iranian financial year, which began on 21 March 2026, according to Ali Akbar Alvandian, secretary of the Cement Industry Employers Association. Higher domestic demand supported output, while clinker production fell by 11% year-on-year, from 44Mt to 39Mt.


Cement and clinker exports declined by 29% year-on-year, including a 67% year-on-year fall in shipments through Iran’s southern borders. Alvandian attributed the decline to disrupted shipments through southern ports and to Iraq, as well as fewer Iraqi import permits.
